description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thalgamuwa, Aranayaka D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610368 (23/0607)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement determining title to multiple specific land parcels (Plot Nos. 1:1 through 1:26) in Thalgamuwa village, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details. The content focuses entirely on land property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters.
